name: AcmeToCasino - Threat Detection and Automated Response

parameters.name: Message

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ ip: $json.source_ip, action: 'deny', comment: $json.incident_id, expires_at: new Date(Date.now() + $json.ttl_seconds * 1000).toISOString() }) }}

parameters.query:
INSERT INTO security_incidents (
  incident_id, detection_type, sub_type, severity, confidence,
  source_ip, action_taken, details, enrichment_json, ttl_seconds,
  expires_at, created_at, environment, platform
) VALUES (
  '{{ $json.incident_id }}',
  '{{ $json.detection_type }}',
  '{{ $json.sub_type || "" }}',
  '{{ $json.severity }}',
  {{ $json.confidence }},
  '{{ $json.source_ip }}',
  '{{ $json.action }}',
  $body${{ $json.details }}$body$,
  $body${{ JSON.stringify($json.enrichment) }}$body$,
  {{ $json.ttl_seconds || 86400 }},
  NOW() + INTERVAL '{{ $json.ttl_seconds || 86400 }} seconds',
  NOW(),
  '{{ $json.environment }}',
  '{{ $json.platform }}'
)
ON CONFLICT (incident_id) DO NOTHING
RETURNING incident_id, created_at;

INSERT INTO blocked_ips (
  ip_address, incident_id, detection_type, severity,
  blocked_at, expires_at, deployment_type, is_active
) VALUES (
  '{{ $json.source_ip }}',
  '{{ $json.incident_id }}',
  '{{ $json.detection_type }}',
  '{{ $json.severity }}',
  NOW(),
  NOW() + INTERVAL '{{ $json.ttl_seconds || 86400 }} seconds',
  '{{ $json.deployment_type }}',
  true
)
ON CONFLICT (ip_address) DO UPDATE
  SET expires_at  = GREATEST(blocked_ips.expires_at, EXCLUDED.expires_at),
      severity    = CASE WHEN EXCLUDED.severity > blocked_ips.severity THEN EXCLUDED.severity ELSE blocked_ips.severity END,
      updated_at  = NOW();

parameters.subject: =[{{ $json.severity }}] AcmeToCasino: {{ $json.detection_type }} - {{ $json.incident_id }}
parameters.message:

Source IP{{ $json.source_ip }}

Action{{ $json.action }}
Auto-Unblock{{ new Date(Date.now() + ($json.ttl_seconds || 86400) * 1000).toISOString() }}

Details:

AcmeToCasino Security SOAR | {{ new Date().toISOString() }}

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ type: 'ipv4-addr', value: $json.source_ip, confidence: Math.round(($json.confidence || 0.75) * 100), labels: ['malicious-activity', $json.detection_type.toLowerCase()], description: $json.details, valid_from: new Date().toISOString(), valid_until: new Date(Date.now() + ($json.ttl_seconds || 86400) * 1000).toISOString(), created_by: 'AcmeToCasino-SOAR', external_references: [{ source_name: 'AcmeToCasino', external_id: $json.incident_id }] }) }}

={{ JSON.stringify({ routing_key: $env.PAGERDUTY_INTEGRATION_KEY, event_action: 'trigger', dedup_key: $json.incident_id, payload: { summary: `[CRITICAL] AcmeToCasino ${$json.detection_type}: ${$json.source_ip} - ${$json.incident_id}`, severity: 'critical', source: $json.source_ip, timestamp: $json.timestamp, component: 'AcmeToCasino Security SOAR', group: 'security', class: $json.detection_type, custom_details: { incident_id: $json.incident_id, detection_type: $json.detection_type, source_ip: $json.source_ip, country: $json.enrichment.country_name, asn: $json.enrichment.asn, action_taken: $json.action, confidence: $json.confidence, details: $json.details } }, links: [{ href: $env.JIRA_BASE_URL + '/browse/' + ($env.JIRA_SECURITY_PROJECT || 'SEC'), text: 'JIRA Security Board' }] }) }}

={{ JSON.stringify({ routing_key: $env.PAGERDUTY_INTEGRATION_KEY, event_action: 'trigger', dedup_key: `ESCALATED-${$json.source_ip}-${Math.floor(Date.now() / 600000)}`, payload: { summary: `[ESCALATED] Ongoing attack from ${$json.source_ip} for ${$json.attack_duration_minutes} minutes`, severity: 'critical', source: $json.source_ip, component: 'AcmeToCasino Security SOAR', class: `ESCALATED_${$json.detection_type}`, custom_details: { attack_duration_minutes: $json.attack_duration_minutes, original_incident: $json.incident_id, escalation_reason: $json.escalation_reason } } }) }}
